Jana Sena Party Political Affairs Committee chairman and Civil Supplies Minister Nadendla Manohar | Photo Credit: File photo
Jana Sena Party Political Affairs Committee chairman and Civil Supplies Minister Nadendla Manohar discussed the conduct of the local body elections with party leaders on Sunday. He explained the strategy outlined by JSP president and Deputy Chief Minister K. Pawan Kalyan for the party to secure success and called for collective efforts to achieve the goal.
Tourism Minister Kandula Durgesh, MP T. Uday Srinivas, MLAs Mandali Buddha Prasad, Vamsikrishna Srinivas, Bolisetti Srinivas and Bathula Balaramakrishna, and JSP leaders Ram Talluri, B. Mahendra Reddy, A.V. Ratnam, Kalyanam Siva Srinivas, Chilakam Madhusudhan Reddy, Chillapalli Srinivasa Rao, Palavalasa Yasaswini, V. Ajay Kumar, P. Prasanth, Pendem Dorababu, P. Subbarayudu and Yanamala Bhaskar attended the meeting.
